operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas appends a color stop to the active gradient in call order.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Retain ordered stops in the gradient descriptor before cached texture/shader creation.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas adds a circular arc to the current path using the active transform.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Emit a Pixi Graphics arc command in the same command order and transform.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas clears the current path without changing paint state.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Begin a new compatibility path buffer without resetting saved state.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas closes the current subpath before fill or stroke.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Close the matching Pixi Graphics subpath.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas creates a gradient in the current user space; addColorStop positions colors on its start-to-end axis before the gradient is used as a paint style.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Create or reuse a declared, content-addressed Pixi gradient texture (or an approved shader) with the same axis, stops, transform, and alpha; do not create it per frame.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas creates a radial gradient from two circles in the current user space; addColorStop positions colors along the radial interpolation before it is used as a paint style.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Create or reuse a declared Pixi radial-gradient texture (or approved shader) with matching circles, stops, transform, clipping, and alpha; cache by normalized gradient inputs.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas draws the observed generated HTMLCanvasElement texture with the active transform and alpha.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Resolve a declared texture-registry ID and draw a Pixi Sprite with equivalent source/destination geometry; cache generated textures.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas adds an ellipse to the current path using the active transform.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Emit an equivalent Pixi Graphics ellipse command.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas fills the current path using the current fill style and alpha.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Commit the compatibility path to Pixi Graphics with the captured fill state.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas fills an axis-aligned rectangle in current user space.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Emit an equivalent Pixi Graphics rectangle and fill command.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas changes the fill paint for later fill operations.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Capture a normalized color or approved gradient descriptor in compatibility state.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas paints the supplied text at the current transformed origin using the active font, fill style, alpha, and text alignment. HOMEOSTASIS observed one 23-character victory-result string.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Use Pixi Text with the declared packaged/system font policy, matching content, fill, alpha, transform, and baseline placement; text must remain presentation-only.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas applies the CSS font shorthand `700 16px system-ui` to subsequent text. The observed use is limited to the victory-result text path.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Map the shorthand to Pixi Text style: 700 weight, 16 logical-pixel size, and the SFHS-approved system/packaged fallback chain; no remote font loading is allowed.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas multiplies later paint alpha by the current alpha value.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Carry normalized alpha through command state and apply it once to the Pixi object or command.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: HOMEOSTASIS observed `multiply`; Canvas composites later drawing with that blend mode.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Accept only the observed `multiply` mapping through the approved Pixi blend table; reject any unlisted mode.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: HOMEOSTASIS sets the Canvas image-smoothing flag for generated texture draws.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Set the declared Pixi texture sampling mode before sprite presentation.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas sets the stroke cap style; HOMEOSTASIS observed `round`.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Map only the observed round cap to the Pixi stroke command.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas appends a line segment to the current path.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Append the equivalent segment to the compatibility path buffer.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas sets stroke width in current user-space units.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Capture width in compatibility state and apply it to the Pixi stroke.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas begins a subpath at the transformed coordinate.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Move the compatibility path cursor to the equivalent coordinate.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas appends a quadratic Bezier segment to the current path.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Append the equivalent Pixi Graphics quadratic curve.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas restores the most recently saved complete drawing state; unmatched restore is a no-op in Canvas and is forbidden by SFHS command validation.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Pop the compatibility state stack and fail conformance on stack underflow.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas post-multiplies the current transform by a rotation.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Post-multiply the compatibility transform with the same radians.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas pushes the complete drawing state, including transform and paint attributes.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Push an immutable compatibility state snapshot.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas post-multiplies the current transform by scale factors.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Post-multiply the compatibility transform with the same factors.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas replaces the current transform with the supplied matrix.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Replace the compatibility transform matrix exactly.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas strokes the current path using current stroke state and alpha.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Commit the compatibility path to Pixi Graphics with captured stroke state.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas strokes an axis-aligned rectangle with current stroke state.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Emit an equivalent Pixi Graphics rectangle stroke.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas changes the stroke paint for later stroke operations.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Capture a normalized solid color in compatibility state.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas sets `textAlign` to `center`, placing the horizontal midpoint of the victory-result text at its transformed x coordinate.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Set the Pixi Text horizontal anchor to 0.5 and place that anchor at the same logical transformed x coordinate; do not move a DOM or Pixi control target.

operations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas post-multiplies the current transform by translation.
operations.proposedPixiBehavior: Post-multiply the compatibility transform with the same offsets.

approximations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas creates a gradient in the current user space; addColorStop positions colors on its start-to-end axis before the gradient is used as a paint style.
approximations.proposedPixiBehavior: Create or reuse a declared, content-addressed Pixi gradient texture (or an approved shader) with the same axis, stops, transform, and alpha; do not create it per frame.
approximations.expectedVisualDifference: Color interpolation and anti-aliased stop edges can differ by renderer and color pipeline; geometry, stop order, alpha, and gradient axis may not change.

approximations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas creates a radial gradient from two circles in the current user space; addColorStop positions colors along the radial interpolation before it is used as a paint style.
approximations.proposedPixiBehavior: Create or reuse a declared Pixi radial-gradient texture (or approved shader) with matching circles, stops, transform, clipping, and alpha; cache by normalized gradient inputs.
approximations.expectedVisualDifference: Subpixel circle coverage, interpolation, and anti-aliased radial edges can differ; the center, radii, opacity, and visual extent may not drift.

approximations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas paints the supplied text at the current transformed origin using the active font, fill style, alpha, and text alignment. HOMEOSTASIS observed one 23-character victory-result string.
approximations.proposedPixiBehavior: Use Pixi Text with the declared packaged/system font policy, matching content, fill, alpha, transform, and baseline placement; text must remain presentation-only.
approximations.expectedVisualDifference: Glyph hinting, kerning, and anti-aliasing may differ between Canvas text and Pixi text, but the content, result meaning, bounds, baseline, and contrast must remain readable.

approximations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas applies the CSS font shorthand `700 16px system-ui` to subsequent text. The observed use is limited to the victory-result text path.
approximations.proposedPixiBehavior: Map the shorthand to Pixi Text style: 700 weight, 16 logical-pixel size, and the SFHS-approved system/packaged fallback chain; no remote font loading is allowed.
approximations.expectedVisualDifference: The browser may rasterize the same system font differently through Pixi; glyph shape can vary slightly but weight, size, content bounds, baseline, and contrast must stay within tolerance.

approximations.exactCanvasBehavior: Canvas sets `textAlign` to `center`, placing the horizontal midpoint of the victory-result text at its transformed x coordinate.
approximations.proposedPixiBehavior: Set the Pixi Text horizontal anchor to 0.5 and place that anchor at the same logical transformed x coordinate; do not move a DOM or Pixi control target.
approximations.expectedVisualDifference: No meaningful alignment difference is allowed. Fractional glyph bounds can differ, but the center anchor and uncovered controls must remain stable.
